Key points:  
- As "AI coworker" forms like Claude Cowork, Hermes, and Perplexity Computer continue to emerge, OpenClaw is also evolving. Its appearance marks a paradigm shift in the role of AI agents, where intelligence begins to possess execution capabilities.  
- Qualcomm Technologies, leveraging its unique positioning, is driving the era of AI agents, enabling intelligent, personalized, and intuitive experiences that operate seamlessly across the intelligent edge (between devices).  
- Our platform is designed for running agent planning on lightweight devices with exceptional energy efficiency.  

Recently, using OpenClaw has been very convenient. Regardless of the device I use, I can send messages to OpenClaw anytime, anywhere. OpenClaw sends me a news briefing every morning, plans healthy walking routes, reminds me of attire suitable for the day's weather, and can track the logistics progress of the audio system I ordered from Japan in real time. OpenClaw can also record my scattered thoughts, convert them into concise Markdown format, and email them to relevant parties. - Con la continua aparición de formas de "compañero de IA" como Claude Cowork, Hermes y Perplexity Computer, OpenClaw también sigue evolucionando, marcando un cambio de paradigma en el papel de los agentes de IA, donde la inteligencia comienza a tener capacidad de ejecución.

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Zaihe Truck announced it has completed a total of 1 billion yuan in financing. As a pioneering leader in the AI heavy truck sector, Zaihe Truck has garnered support from top VCs including BV Baidu Ventures, Suzhou Venture Capital, and Lushi Investment, and has established deep "investment + industry chain" partnerships with renowned industry players such as Horizon Robotics, Chuangyuan Group, and Wan'an Technology. It has also secured comprehensive financial backing from five major state-owned banks, including Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and China Construction Bank. Thus, Zaihe Truck has achieved a closed-loop capital strategy integrating "equity + debt + industry." Leveraging the commercialization foundation of large-scale product deliveries, Zaihe Truck is accelerating on the highly differentiated track of "cloud-integrated AI heavy trucks," aiming to continuously build the world's best new energy intelligent heavy trucks and achieve large-scale deployment of "truly unmanned and truly safe heavy trucks," driving the full acceleration of Physical AI In Motion through hardcore innovation. Currently, as China's "dual carbon" strategy deepens, the green and low-carbon transformation of the transportation sector has become a core direction for developing new quality productive forces. The state has explicitly called for vigorously developing electric and hydrogen-powered heavy trucks, building zero-carbon transport corridors, and promoting the large-scale application of vehicle-road-cloud integrated intelligent transportation systems. New energy intelligent heavy trucks and autonomous driving are entering a strategic window of opportunity with policy, market, and capital alignment. In 2025, Zaihe Truck was recognized as a potential Chinese unicorn enterprise and a Jiangsu Province dual-innovation talent enterprise, and ranked among the top three new heavy truck players in delivery volume.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Zaihe Truck anunció que ha completado una ronda de financiación de 1.000 millones de yuanes. Como líder emergente en el sector de los camiones pesados con inteligencia artificial, Zaihe Truck cuenta con el respaldo de destacados capitalistas de riesgo como BV Baidu Ventures, Suzhou Venture Capital Group y Lushi Investment. Además, ha establecido una profunda cooperación de "inversión + cadena industrial" con empresas reconocidas como Horizon Robotics, Chuangyuan Group y Wanan Technology. Asimismo, ha obtenido un apoyo financiero integral de los cinco grandes bancos estatales, incluidos el Banco Industrial y Comercial de China y el Banco de Construcción de China. De este modo, Zaihe Truck ha completado un círculo cerrado de estrategia de capital que integra "capital social, deuda e industria". Basándose en la comercialización de entregas a gran escala, Zaihe Truck avanza en el altamente diferenciado sector de los "camiones pesados con IA integrada en vehículo y nube".
